instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe unless the script inputs specify otherwise.
indicators: Inputs (source declarations): atrPeriod1 = input(10, "ATR Length 1"); factor1 = input.float(1.0, "ATR Factor 1", step = 0.01); atrPeriod2 = input(11, "ATR Length 2"); factor2 = input.float(2.0, "ATR Factor 2", step = 0.01); atrPeriod3 = input(12, "ATR Length 3"); factor3 = input.float(3.0, "ATR Factor 3", step = 0.01); len = input.int(233, minval=1, title="Trend-EMA Length"); src = input(close, title="Source"); offset = input.int(title="Offset", defval=0, minval=-500, maxval=500); backtest_timeframe_start = input.time(defval = timestamp("01 Apr 2016 13:30 +0000"), title = "Backtest Start Time"); USE_ENDTIME = input(false,title="Define the ending period for backtests (If false, will test up to most recent candle)"); backtest_timeframe_end = input.time(defval = timestamp("19 Mar 2021 19:30 +0000"), title = "Backtest End Time"); TARGET_PROFIT_MODE = input(false,title="Exit when Risk:Reward met"); REWARD_RATIO = input(3,title="Risk:[Reward] (i.e. 3) for exit"); TSL_ON = input(true,title="Use trailing stop loss"); ATR_multi = input(2, "ATR multiplier for stop loss") | Indicator calls: ta.supertrend(factor1, atrPeriod1); ta.supertrend(factor2, atrPeriod2); ta.supertrend(factor3, atrPeriod3); ta.ema(src, len); ta.lowest(low, 1); ta.highest(high,1); ta.atr(ATR_multi_len)
entry_long: Source rule: (extremebullish with all conditions true not extremebullish[1]) with all conditions true (emacolor equals color.green)
exit: Source rule: close  exceeds  entry_price; order: strategy.close("Long", comment="take profit [trailing]"); Source rule: close  is at most  entry_price; order: strategy.close("Long", comment="stop loss"); Source rule: take_profit_long; order: strategy.close("Long", comment="take profits [risk:reward]"); Source rule: take_profit_long; order: strategy.close("Long", comment="exit[rsi]")
position_sizing: Source strategy() declaration determines defaults when present; no exchange risk budget is inferred. See source for qty/default_qty_type/default_qty_value.
filters: Only conditions present in the cited source are represented in entry rules; no external filters added.
implementation_notes: Paraphrased from the cited Pine source file. Third-party Pine source; verify execution timing, pyramiding, and broker-emulator semantics before implementation.
